environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only) in a private VPC subnet. The service is accessed by internal microservices via the NLB DNS endpoint. Security group allows TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. No application-layer inspection. SQLite database at /var/data/users.db contains production user records including api_key column. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2 with Python 3.9, gunicorn with 4 workers.

config.network: private subnet, SG allows 10.0.0.0/8 on TCP/8080
